public_brand: Owner, 2026-10-28: the public brand is Equity Uprise, not Human Uprise. Every public-facing name (titles, descriptions, Open Graph and Twitter tags, JSON-LD names, headings, product copy, llms.txt) says Equity Uprise; the mccluster.org root shares as Equity Uprise · McCluster with site name McCluster Corp. Human Uprise survives only as a legacy technical identifier where compatibility needs it: the humanuprise.com host and its routing, this file's human_uprise key, file names, function and variable names, CSS classes, storage keys, event names, URL paths and @ids. docs/control-plane/DOMAINS-AND-ENTITIES.md -> The public brand is Equity Uprise.
rule: Two related but distinct canonical web properties. mccluster.org is McCluster Corp's house; matthew.mccluster.org is Matthew McCluster's house. Do not collapse them, do not make the two entities interchangeable, and do not move a working URL merely for tidiness.

url_ownership._rule: Ownership decides navigation, metadata and which entity a page is about. It does not by itself move a URL. Every path here keeps working where it is.

company_private_development_unpublished.status: private development, unpublished: served on no host, absent from navigation, sitemap and llms.txt
company_private_development_unpublished.owner_words: The facility must be moved to a non-visible part of the site to be developed privately.

url_ownership.why_company_apps_stay_put: Sessions are per-origin localStorage (js/backend.js), checkout returns and the Supabase Auth redirect allowlist name matthew.mccluster.org, and printed QR codes and live campaign links point at these paths. Moving the World, accounts or checkout to mccluster.org would sign members out and break returns. The company property describes these products and links into them; it does not re-host them.

edge.now: Cloudflare zone redirect rule: mccluster.org/*, www.mccluster.org/* and here.mccluster.org/* -> 301 https://matthew.mccluster.org/$1 (checked 2026-10-03). Sharing mccluster.org therefore shows Matthew's album preview.
edge.target: mccluster.org/* and www.mccluster.org/* routed to Worker mccluster. The company router serves the company pages and answers every other path with the same 301 to https://matthew.mccluster.org/$1, so every existing link, QR code and campaign funnel keeps landing where it does today. here.mccluster.org keeps its redirect rule.
activation_owner_steps: Merge the PR; confirm https://api.mccluster.org/v1/health reports the merged SHA.
Cloudflare -> Workers Routes: add mccluster.org/* and www.mccluster.org/* -> Worker mccluster.

Cloudflare -> Rules -> Redirect Rules: narrow the redirect rule to here.mccluster.org only (redirect rules run before Workers, so the Worker sees nothing until this changes). Rollback is re-widening the rule.
Supabase -> Authentication -> URL Configuration -> Redirect URLs: add https://mccluster.org/** so ordinary sign-in on the host may return to it (the bar's handoff needs nothing).

Verify (owner, 2026-10-15: the root is the World): curl -I https://mccluster.org/ -> 200, the World (mnet.html) with this host's head: title Equity Uprise · McCluster, canonical https://mccluster.org/, og:site_name McCluster Corp, no noindex; curl -I https://mccluster.org/company -> 200 company page; curl -I 'https://mccluster.org/action/' -> 200, a World room with x-robots-tag noindex; curl -I https://mccluster.org/docket-516.html -> 301 to https://matthew.mccluster.org/docket-516.html; curl -I https://www.mccluster.org/ -> 301 to https://mccluster.org/; curl -I http://mccluster.org/ -> 301 to https://mccluster.org/ (the Worker answers it; Cloudflare SSL/TLS -> Edge Certificates -> Always Use HTTPS covers the zone as well).
Search Console: add the mccluster.org URL-prefix property (DNS TXT verification records already exist), submit https://mccluster.org/sitemap.xml.
Supply a 1200x630 McCluster Corp share card; until then the company preview uses the supplied M mark (assets/img/m-mark.png), unaltered.
edge.mx_note: mccluster.org mail is Google Workspace MX. Routing HTTP to a Worker does not touch MX; do not replace the apex DNS record with a Worker custom domain without checking the MX and TXT records survive.

human_uprise.target: humanuprise.com/* and www.humanuprise.com/* routed to Worker mccluster. The humanuprise.com router (workers/mccluster/src/human-uprise/router.js) serves the World at / and the World's rooms and files from the personal origin, and answers every other path with a 301 to https://matthew.mccluster.org/$1.
activation_owner_steps: Merge and deploy; confirm https://api.mccluster.org/v1/health reports the merged SHA.
Cloudflare -> humanuprise.com zone -> Workers Routes: humanuprise.com/* and www.humanuprise.com/* -> Worker mccluster, with proxied DNS records and no redirect rule in front.
Supabase Auth -> URL configuration: allow https://humanuprise.com/auth/ and https://humanuprise.com/reset-password.html.
Verify: curl -I https://humanuprise.com/ (200, canonical to itself); https://humanuprise.com/album.html (301 to matthew.mccluster.org); https://www.humanuprise.com/ (301 to the apex).
Set WORLD_ORIGIN in js/tabbar.js to https://humanuprise.com/ so the Globe on Matthew's site opens the World's own door.
